intro: Blind Builder: your team builds a secret construction from its own objects. The builder keeps their eyes closed, the director is the only one who sees the AI's plan and may not touch anything. Another team is referee. The AI compares your photo with the plan.
warmup: Warm-up: builder, eyes closed! Build a tower of three objects in 30 seconds, using words only.

private.blueprint: The secret plan: {plan} You touch nothing; speak only.
blueprint.fallback: Lay {items} objects in a row from small to large; put the smallest object on top of the largest.

clean.reason: Round {n}: referee confirms fair building (eyes closed, director touched nothing)
clean.default: Round {n}: no referee available; fair building assumed
clean.no: Round {n}: referee does not confirm fair building; no bonus
